concerns.text: FR-006 specifies fitting a GLMM to binary pass@1 outcomes derived from a *single* code generation per (problem, model, prompt‑variant) triplet. Because pass@1 with n=1 is a highly stochastic indicator, using only one observation per condition provides insufficient replication for reliable estimation of interaction effects; the resulting GLMM coefficients and p‑values will be driven by sampling noise rather than true effects.
